# Team retrospective

Run after a multi-agent task is complete and its applicable checks are green,
before dismissing its agents. Explicit user instructions to retain agents or
finish early take precedence. Do not spawn agents solely to run this skill.

1. Identify agents, tabs, and sessions owned by this task using the environment's
   actual inventory and recorded ownership. Preserve other tasks and sessions.
2. Ask each reachable agent for a concise factual report: what went wrong, failed
   approaches, tool or coordination problems, resolutions, and unresolved items.
   Ask them to distinguish direct observation from inference. A clean report may
   say no issues. Do not request new implementation or speculative findings.
3. Collect each response, or label it unavailable with the reason. Preserve useful
   findings and a concise summary in an appropriate task artifact; avoid secrets,
   unnecessary transcripts, and public disclosure. Report recurring issues and
   unresolved items to the user. Claims remain reports until independently verified.
4. Confirm work and required handoffs are preserved. Dismiss the task-owned agents
   and close only their task-owned tabs or panes when safe; verify the result.
   Follow the environment's skill and safety rules. Never stop a shared server or
   close another task's session. Respect explicit instructions to keep agents.
5. If work is blocked, unfinished, or still active, preserve the agents and report
   the blocker instead of treating the task as green. If the environment cannot
   contact or dismiss an agent, report the limitation; never claim it was dismissed.
